# Hugo Narrow 2.0.2

Patch release for Hugo Narrow 2.0.

## Fixes

- Removed the SVG sprite preload. External `<use>` references cannot reuse a preload response, so browsers downloaded the sprite twice and Chrome reported an unused-preload warning. The sprite is now requested once and cached by its fingerprinted URL.
- Changed the dock container from `nav` to `div` so `role="toolbar"` is valid. This fixes the Lighthouse `aria-allowed-role` audit.
- Simplified the dock menu button to the `menu` icon and switched the TOC button to the `toc` icon. Removed the unused expanded/collapsed icon styles.
- Added `announcement.autoClose`. When set to a positive number of seconds, the announcement closes itself and records the dismissal for the browser session.
- Updated the demo and documentation to use the `x` icon for the X social link.

## Icons

- Removed 26 unused icons: `arrow-down`, `arrow-left`, `blog`, `book-open`, `briefcase`, `check`, `chevron-up`, `clock`, `contact`, `edit`, `folder`, `list`, `location`, `message`, `monitor`, `moon`, `phone`, `related`, `series`, `star`, `status`, `tag`, `text`, `twitter`, `user`, `wide`.
- The bundled sprite dropped from about 27 KB to about 17.5 KB.
- Social brand icons and the icons used by the demo are kept.

## Compatibility

No template or configuration changes are required. If a site referenced one of the removed icons in a menu or the `icon` shortcode, switch to an icon that still exists or add the SVG back to `assets/icons/`. See the [2.0.0 release notes](https://github.com/tom2almighty/hugo-narrow/releases/tag/v2.0.0) for the 2.0 migration list.
